title: Asking a Multimodal LLM Whether Someone Fell: Zero-Shot Screening of Low-Resolution Thermal Video in a Laboratory and an Occupied Home
abstract: arXiv:2610.29913v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thermal cameras can watch over older people living alone without capturing faces, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) can judge a short video without task-specific training. We evaluate a production multimodal LLM, Gemini 3.8 Flash at temperature 0, as the decision stage of an event-triggered fall screener, used exactly as a deployed prototype uses it: one request per short thermal clip, with its sound track when there is one, and its predecessor Gemini 3.7 Flash on the same requests. On 438 staged falls and 563 non-fall windows that we located by hand in a public 32x24 thermal dataset, the deployed request called 69% of the held-out subjects' falls (67% over all subjects; bed falls excluded) and none of 499 non-fall windows, including people lying on the floor and getting up. translated_title: 询问多模态大语言模型是否有人摔倒：在实验室与实际居住家庭中对低分辨率热成像视频的零样本筛查
translated_abstract: 热成像摄像头可以在不捕捉人脸的情况下照护独居老人，而多模态大语言模型（LLM）无需针对特定任务的训练即可判断一段短视频。我们评估了生产级多模态LLM——温度参数设为0的Gemini 3.8 Flash——作为事件触发式跌倒筛查器的决策阶段，其使用方式与已部署原型完全一致：对每个短热成像片段发送一次请求，若存在音轨则连同音轨一起发送，并在相同的请求上测试其前身Gemini 3.7 Flash。在一个公开的32x24分辨率热成像数据集中，我们手工定位了438次摆拍跌倒和563个非跌倒窗口，部署的请求对留出受试者的跌倒识别率达69%（全部受试者为67%；排除床上跌倒），且在499个非跌倒窗口中零误报，其中包括躺在地板上以及起身的人。在一个实际有人的居住环境中记录的76小时日常生活视频（160x120分辨率、带声音）中，395个片段无一被判定为跌倒（95%置信上界为每……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究将生产级多模态大语言模型（Gemini）作为零样本决策模块，用于低分辨率热成像视频的跌倒筛查，在实验室数据集上对留出受试者实现69%的跌倒识别率且零误报，并在真实居住环境76小时监测中未产生任何误报警。
en_tdlr: This study employs a production multimodal LLM (Gemini) as a zero-shot decision stage for fall screening from low-resolution thermal video, achieving 69% recall on held-out subjects with zero false alarms in a laboratory dataset and no false alarms over 76 hours of monitoring in an occupied home.
